title: About | Sebastian Sanchez
description: Learn more about Sebastian Sanchez Sandoval, a software engineer focused on backend systems, web applications, production mobile apps, and maintainable architecture.
ogDescription: Software engineer focused on scalable systems, clean architecture, and thoughtful product engineering.
heading: Software engineer. Product builder.
intro: I’m Sebastian Sanchez Sandoval, a software engineer and founder of VAUL Software. Based in Colombia, I build my own products and software solutions for businesses across backend, web, and mobile.
profileNote: Backend, web and mobile. Product-minded by habit.
bio: I care about the whole journey: understanding a need, turning it into software, and improving it once it reaches the people who use it.

story.title: What drives me
paragraphs: With CourtRank, I have worked through that cycle end to end: data modeling, APIs, web and mobile interfaces, deployment, and iteration. Having a published iOS app and a live website gives technical decisions concrete consequences.

PlayZone VIP represents another side of my work: listening to a client and translating their needs into a clear, responsive, published website. MVNEX gives me room to explore C++, terminal tools, and the developer experience.
I like moving between three perspectives: the person using the product, the person who needs the business to run, and the person who will maintain the code. That overlap shapes my decisions.

now.title: Right now
items: Finishing my Computer Engineering degree at Universidad de La Sabana.
Building VAUL Software, CourtRank, and MVNEX.
Preparing for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate certification.
Open to freelance projects, collaboration and remote opportunities.

focus.title: From the system to the experience.

items.title: Backend systems
items.body: Java 17, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, Maven, Flyway and PostgreSQL. I like building things that scale gracefully and fail predictably.

items.title: Web development
items.body: From Next.js and Astro to plain TypeScript. I care about fast, accessible, and maintainable frontends.

items.title: Mobile
items.body: React Native and Expo for cross-platform products. I focus on the connection between mobile UX and the systems behind it.

items.title: Architecture
items.body: Clean separation, clear boundaries, honest tradeoffs. I try to make complexity manageable, not hidden.

items.title: Understand first
items.body: I want to know what the product needs to do before deciding how to build it.

items.title: Ship, then improve
items.body: Working software beats perfect plans. I'd rather put something real in front of users and iterate.

items.title: Keep it maintainable
items.body: Code is read far more than it's written. Clarity and consistency matter a lot to me.

outsideCode.title: Also me
outsideCode.intro: There is life beyond code, too. Sports, curiosity, and attention to detail shape how I look at problems.

company.title: VAUL Software
company.body: I founded VAUL Software to bring together my own products and software development for clients. It is where I connect what I learn building software with concrete business needs.

projects.name: CourtRank
projects.body: An own product for padel clubs.
